ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What type of leaf is not divided into parts?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture has illustrations of several kinds of leaves. The leaves on the left and in the middle are composed of multiple small leaflets, looking like leaves divided into multiple parts. At the lower right there is a single complete leaf blade, not divided into multiple leaflets. Reasoning: The question asks “what type is a leaf that is not divided into parts.” In botany, if a leaf has only one complete blade that is not divided into leaflets, it is called a simple leaf; one divided into multiple leaflets is called a compound leaf. Therefore the answer is Simple Leaf.
